terroir

Geo-point environmental and agricultural-economics data collector. Hand terroir a coordinate and a date range and get back a tidy, provenance-stamped series of climate, weather, vegetation-index, soil, elevation or agricultural-economics data, pulled from many free sources behind one contract.

terroir is the data-collector member of the ORCHESTRA – a producer that supplies covariates and forcings to flexyBayes, kernR and PESTO. See ../CONSTELLATION_MEMBER.md and the contract spec inst/geo_point_contract.md (C6).

Related packages

  • geodata downloads geographic data for spatial analysis and mapping, including climate, crops, elevation, land use and soil.
  • nasapower is a client for the NASA POWER global meteorology, solar energy and climatology API.
  • weatherOz downloads and formats Australian weather and climate data, including SILO.

terroir calls these packages, among others, as optional sources. It adds one request for a point and a date range, one table layout for every source, a provenance record on each result, offline replay from recorded data, and optional coarsening of exact coordinates before any request leaves the machine.

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("max578/terroir")

Minimal example 

library(terroir)

req <- geo_point_request(
  lon = 138.6, lat = -34.92,        # Adelaide
  start = "2020-01-01", end = "2020-01-10",
  variables = c("T2M", "PRECTOTCORR"),
  source = "nasapower"
)

# offline = TRUE answers from a shipped fixture -- no network egress,
# no source package required. Drop it (or set offline = FALSE) for a live pull.
series <- collect_point(req, offline = TRUE)
series

Design

  • One contract (C6). geo_point_request() -> collect_point() -> geo_point_series (a tidy data.table with a fixed schema + mandatory provenance, validated by verify_geo_series()).
  • Sources are optional adapters. Each source package is in Suggests; terroir builds and R CMD checks clean with none installed. A missing source returns a structured refusal, never an error (is_refusal()).
  • Free-only. register_source() refuses any adapter that is not free.
  • Offline replay. offline = TRUE answers from a recorded fixture with zero network egress – reproducible pipelines, continuous integration, and sovereign coordinates that must never reach an upstream service.
  • Sovereign coordinates. sovereign = TRUE coarsens an exact GPS point to roughly a one-kilometre cell before any upstream call; both the raw and the coarsened point are kept in provenance.

Sources

Twelve adapters are registered; list_sources() shows them.

id what it returns key
nasapower global daily climate and solar radiation none
silo SILO 5 km daily weather, Australia (via weatherOz) free email key
abares gridded farm economics (read.abares) none
modis MODIS NDVI/EVI, 16-day (MODISTools) none
stac Sentinel-2 NDVI via Planetary Computer (rsi) none
ocular Sentinel-2 / Landsat index series over a 500 m window, cloud-masked none
nert TERN soil, soil moisture, evapotranspiration, canopy height, Australia free TERN key
isric SoilGrids soil profile by depth layer (apsimx) none
soilgrids SoilGrids 2.0 means, nine properties at four depths to 60 cm (geodata) none
worldclim WorldClim 2.1 bioclimatic variables bio_1 to bio_19 (geodata) none
elevation SRTM 90 m elevation and slope (geodata) none
chirps CHIRPS 2.0 daily rainfall, 50 S to 50 N none

worldclim and elevation are free for non-commercial use only, and the licence is recorded in each series. soilgrids is CC BY 4.0 and chirps is public domain. GSODR is enrolled and not yet registered.

collect_points() takes many requests at once. The gridded sources and nert answer a whole set of sites in one upstream call, and the result has a call column holding that call. Downloaded rasters go to the directory in options(terroir.cache_dir = ), by default the user cache directory for terroir.

Status

The contract machinery, offline replay and coordinate coarsening are complete and tested; nasapower, modis, abares and stac are verified end-to-end against recorded goldens, and ocular against a live two-sensor regression pilot. Live golden fixtures for the network/key adapters are regenerated by data-raw/regenerate_golden.R.
